name: Vigil New Tab
description: Vigil's lean, dark new-tab page. Clock, search, configurable shortcuts. Local-only; no network calls beyond the favicon proxy.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' https://www.google.com/s2/favicons; connect-src 'none'
